item.title: Scottish Arbitration Centre and ICSID enter into cooperation agreement
item.description: The Scottish Arbitration Centre (SAC) and the International Centre for Settlement of Investment Disputes (ICSID) have entered into a cooperation agreement to advance international dispute resolution.SAC and ICSID will cooperate to promote and disseminate knowledge of arbitration, conciliation, mediation, and other alternative methods of dispute resolution, and to share hearing and meetings facilities and services.The agreement was signed by Gillian Carmichael Lemaire, Chair of the Board of SAC, and Martina Polasek, Secretary-General of ICSID.

item.title: ICSID Convention
item.description: The ICSID Convention is a treaty ratified by 159 Contracting States. It entered into force on October 14, 1966, 30 days after ratification by the first 20 States. Article 6 of the ICSID Convention requires the Administrative Council of ICSID to adopt rules of procedure for arbitration and conciliation and for the administrative and financial regulation of the Centre.
item.author: ICSID

item.title: Convention CIRDI
item.description: La Convention CIRDI est un traité ratifié par 159 États contractants. Elle est entrée en vigueur le 14 octobre 1966, soit 30 jours après sa ratification par les 20 premiers États. L'article 6 de la Convention CIRDI dispose que le Conseil administratif du CIRDI adopte les règlements de procédure relatifs à l'arbitrage et à la conciliation et le règlement administratif et financier du Centre.
item.author: ICSID

item.title: Convenio del CIADI
item.description: El Convenio del CIADI es un tratado ratificado por 159 Estados Contratantes. Entró en vigor el día 14 de octubre de 1966, 30 días después de la ratificación por parte de los primeros 20 Estados. El Artículo 6 del Convenio del CIADI le exige al Consejo Administrativo del CIADI que adopte tanto reglas procesales aplicables al arbitraje y a la conciliación como el reglamento administrativo y financ
item.author: ICSID

item.title: ICSID Releases Caseload Statistics for the 2026 Fiscal Year
item.description: August 14, 2026. The latest edition of The ICSID Caseload - Statistics reflects sustained and growing demand for ICSID’s services during Fiscal Year 2026 (FY2026), spanning from July 1, 2025, to June 30, 2026. During this period, ICSID administered 363 cases, the highest number of cases in a fiscal year in its history.
item.author: ICSID

item.title: Honduras Ratifies the ICSID Convention
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — On July 17, 2026, the Republic of Honduras deposited its Instrument of Ratification of the Convention on the Settlement of Investment Disputes between States and Nationals of Other States (the ICSID Convention) with the World Bank, becoming the 159th Contracting State to the Convention.In accordance with Article 68(2), the ICSID Convention will enter into force for Honduras on August 16, 2026.
item.author: ICSID

item.title: Honduras ratifica el Convenio del CIADI
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — El 17 de julio de 2026, la República de Honduras depositó su instrumento de ratificación del Convenio sobre Arreglo de Diferencias Relativas a Inversiones entre Estados y Nacionales de Otros Estados (el Convenio del CIADI) ante el Banco Mundial, convirtiéndose en el Estado número 159 en ratificar el Convenio del CIADI.
item.author: ICSID

item.title: Le Honduras ratifie la Convention du CIRDI
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — Le 17 juillet 2026, la République du Honduras a déposé son instrument de ratification de la Convention internationale pour le règlement des différends relatifs aux investissements entre États et ressortissants d’autres États (la Convention CIRDI) auprès de la Banque mondiale, devenant ainsi le 159ème État contractant à la Convention.Conformément à l'article 68(2), la Convention CIRDI entrera en vigueur à l’égard de le Honduras le 16 août 2026.
item.author: ICSID

item.description: La Carga de Casos del CIADI - Estadísticas contiene un perfil de la carga de casos del CIADI desde el registro del primer caso en el año 1972. item.title: The ICSID Caseload - Statistics
item.description: The ICSID Caseload - Statistics contains a profile of the ICSID caseload since the first case was registered in 1972. The ICSID Caseload - Statistics is a valuable empirical reference for practitioners and policymakers to track trends and developments in international investment dispute settlement. It profiles various aspects of international investment cases, including the number of cases, the basis of consent invoked by claimants, geographic and economic sector distribution of cases, outcomes of proceedings, and the nationality of arbitrator
item.author: ICSID

item.title: Affaires du CIRDI - Statistiques
item.description: La publication Affaires du CIRDI – Statistiques dresse le profil des affaires du CIRDI depuis la première instance, enregistrée en 1972. Le CIRDI a accueilli la majorité des affaires connues en matière d'investissement international et la publication Affaires du CIRDI – Statistiques constitue une référence empirique précieuse sur les tendances générales dans le règlement des différends en matière d'investissement international.

item.title: ICSID Model Fact-Finding Clauses
item.description: The ICSID Model Fact-Finding Clauses offer ready-to-use drafting language for parties who wish to refer specific matters to ICSID-administered fact-finding. They are designed for use in contracts between foreign investors and States or Regional Economic Integration Organizations (REIOs), including subdivisions of States and agencies of States or REIOs. Grounded in the ICSID framework, these clauses provide a reliable mechanism for establishing a neutral, structured process to examine and determine relevant facts in the context of contract-based investment relationships.
item.author: ICSID

item.title: ICSID Model Mediation Clauses
item.description: The ICSID Model Mediation Clauses offer ready-to-use drafting language for parties who wish to resolve disputes through ICSID-administered mediation. They are designed for use in contracts between foreign investors and States or Regional Economic Integration Organizations (REIOs), including subdivisions of States and agencies of States or REIOs. These clauses leverage the credibility and structure of the ICSID framework to facilitate an efficient, consensus-driven approach to resolving contract-based investment disputes.
item.author: ICSID

item.title: ICSID Model Conciliation Clauses
item.description: The ICSID Model Conciliation Clauses offer ready-to-use drafting language for parties who wish to resolve disputes through ICSID-administered conciliation. They are designed for use in contracts between foreign investors and States, including constituent subdivisions or agencies of States, and in certain circumstances, Regional Economic Integration Organizations (REIOs) or their agencies. These clauses draw on the ICSID framework to provide a structured, internationally recognized basis for conciliation in contract-based investment disputes.
item.author: ICSID

item.title: ICSID Model Arbitration Clauses
item.description: The ICSID Model Arbitration Clauses offer ready-to-use drafting language for parties who wish to resolve disputes through ICSID-administered arbitration. They are designed for use in contracts between foreign investors and States, including constituent subdivisions or agencies of States, and in certain circumstances, Regional Economic Integration Organizations (REIOs) or their agencies. These clauses are grounded in ICSID’s established framework for contract-based investment dispute resolution and are not intended to substitute independent legal advice.
